name: RoVPN

catalog.method: Google Tink AesGcmHkdfStreaming: PBKDF2-HmacSHA256 100000 iters + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM segments; ED: fields are Base32 of cleartext
catalog.notes: Live body byte-identical to V2OVPN (same endpoint, same key_secured, same catalog). Endpoint is chunked without Content-Length; script uses http.client and retries (no Range).

filesNote: profile.json legacy (Base64 -> modified XXTEA delta 0x2E0BA747) supported. profile.enc is Tink + Android Keystore master key: NOT openable offline, reported as PROFILE_ENC_KEYSTORE.
